Figure 2: Overview of our proposed SaLon3R. Given every unposed and uncalibrated image as input, an incremental reconstruction network initially predicts the camera parameters 𝐊 t , 𝐏 t \mathbf{K}_{t},\mathbf{P}_{t} , pointmaps 𝐗 ^ t \hat{\mathbf{X}}_{t} , and pixel-wise Gaussian latents 𝐆 ^ t \hat{\mathbf{G}}_{t} . A saliency-aware quantization mechanism is designed to encode dense Gaussians into compact Gaussian anchors, reducing redundancy while maintaining geometric fidelity.
